GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Guided reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided reading.

2. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.

3. When practising Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive speaking.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Interactive speaking.

4. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.

5. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

6. When practising Oral expressions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral expressions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral expressions.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Oral expressions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expressions.

7. When practising Selective Listening, Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.

8. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Schule
   C. Buch
   D. Wasser

9. When practising Guided Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading.

10. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Thank you
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Good night

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Functional writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Creative writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Functional writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided reading.

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive speaking.

4. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral expressions.

7. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening, Imitative speaking.

8. B — Schule

9. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.

10. C — Good day / hello

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)

14. (4 marks)
